bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CHECK=GAYBBS_REPORT_PRODUCTION_READONLY\n'
printf 'GSERVER_HEAD='; git -C /home/gace/Project/Gserver/repository rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'BOT_CONTAINERS_BEGIN\n'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Image}}|{{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|gateapp|tg.*bot' || true
printf 'BOT_CONTAINERS_END\n'
for d in /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/GateApp-Bot /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot; do if test -d "$d/.git" || git -C "$d" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'CHECKOUT=%s\n' "$d"; printf 'HEAD='; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD; printf 'BRANCH='; git -C "$d" branch --show-current; printf 'DIRTY='; test -z "$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain)" && echo NO || echo YES; fi; done
